top_signals.title: South Korea's Kospi swings from bear to bull-market territory in just over a month on AI trade
top_signals.summary: South Korean stocks rallied on Thursday, pushing the benchmark Kospi into a technical bull market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Housing Market Jitters Grip Australia Banks on Cautious Outlook
top_signals.summary: Banks revealed the extent of the depressed housing market sentiment in Australia this week, dragging down their share prices and underscoring the pressure on profitability.

top_signals.title: GoTo’s Fall From Grace Deepens With Removal From MSCI Indexes
top_signals.summary: MSCI Inc. removed GoTo Group from its indexes after a plunge in the former Indonesian tech darling’s share price left the stock difficult to trade.
